title: [GACT]Golden Apple Composite Table
description: An data pack,After installing this, you can synthesize golden apples in the workbench
body:
**Do you have any worries about the original MInecraft not being able to synthesize golden apples?**
 _This data package may help you!_
 ![Crafting recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee70b46c84a73455a6aa066fdf4bb4ab82942d65.png)
 You hava this data pack,you can easy synthesis golden Apple!
